summary_md: **Ian Silva ([@iamnsilva](https://x.com/iamnsilva/status/2115713824263426385))** flags a new open-source project, **3d-model-anything**, a Swift iPhone app that captures LiDAR and photos and reconstructs an editable Three.js room for browser exploration, cautioning that it is very new ([GitHub link as posted](https://github.com/wesbos/3d-mode)).
relevance: Capture-to-3D pipeline that agents could build scenes from.
